A 147/2010. Korm. rendelet a fokozottan: For highly sensitive areas, Government Decree 147/2010 expressly ties the possibility of infiltrating treated wastewater to the water base protection rules, and Government Decree 123/1997 assigns protective zones and areas to water bases. These do not amount to a single figure in metres but to a site-dependent geometry.
A 147/2010. Korm. rendelet maga is előír: Government Decree 147/2010 itself requires septic tank and individual biological systems to be sized taking account of the soil's conditions, the depth of the subsurface water and the volume of wastewater. Further conditions apply in areas with high groundwater and in highly sensitive areas. Knowing a single figure is therefore not enough.
A 147/2010. Korm. rendelet szerinti egye: The individual wastewater treatment category under Government Decree 147/2010 extends to a load of 1–50 PE. Above that the project follows a different regulatory and permitting route, and the design becomes an engineering task.

It treats the wastewater inside the unit: microorganisms living in the aerated system break down
                organic matter in the presence of oxygen. The process ends in treated water
                suitable for infiltration and reed-bed use. We recommend it for family homes and
                for regularly used properties. An absence of a few weeks typically causes no

A szennyvizet a következő\n s:
It stores the wastewater until the next emptying; no treatment happens inside it and no
            treated water is produced — nothing leaves the system except by tanker. There is
            no biological process to maintain, so it is indifferent to whether the property is
            used evenly or only occasionally: after a long gap it works exactly as before. In
            return it needs regular emptying, at a frequency set by the tank's size and the
            actual water use — and the running cost follows from that. It matters that the
            tanker can reach the tank safely. Its place is where local conditions permit
            nothing to enter the ground at all, and no other solution is possible.
A szennyvizet a telken belül megtisztítj: It treats the wastewater within the plot, and the treated water can be soaked away or — where the conditions are met — put to use. For permanent occupation this is the most common solution. It needs electricity, and regular but light operating attention.
A szennyvizet ténylegesen megtisztítja,: It genuinely cleans the wastewater, so the treated water can be disposed of over a considerably smaller area and, in favourable cases, put to use. It needs electricity and calls for regular — but light — operating attention.

Mert nem tudjuk. A nem közművel elvezete: Because we do not know it. Collecting domestic wastewater not carried by mains is a public service: the charge is set by the utility and the local authority, separately for each settlement, and there is no public, consolidated register of it. Mert ott a tisztítás jelentős része a ta: Because there a significant part of the treatment happens in the soil, not in the unit. Mert üzleti és intézményi projektnél a k: Because on a business or institutional project a price quoted from capacity or bed count would mislead.
